title: Notifications
lead: Corporate actions on your bonds, payouts, meetings and verification decisions.
emptyBody: New corporate actions, payouts and decisions will appear here.
unavailable: Notifications are unavailable. The registrar API did not answer.

action_announced.title: {ticker}: new corporate action
action_announced.body: {actionKind} announced on a bond you hold. Check its record and payment dates.

meeting_opened.title: {ticker}: bondholder meeting opened
meeting_opened.body: Your vote counts in proportion to your units at the record date.

meeting_finalized.title: {ticker}: meeting result
meeting_finalized.body: The votes are counted. See the outcome.

entitlement_paid.title: {ticker}: payment received
entitlement_paid.body: Your payout was sent to your wallet; the statement is ready.

kyc_approved.title: Verification approved
kyc_approved.body: Your wallet is attested and registered in the issues you chose.

kyc_rejected.title: Verification rejected
kyc_rejected.body: Reason: {reason}. Fix it and apply again.

action_defaulted.title: {ticker}: payment in default
action_defaulted.body: The issuer did not fund the payment in time. Your claim as a holder of record stays on-chain until it is cured.

default_cured.title: {ticker}: default cured
default_cured.body: The issuer funded the payment late; the holders of record are being paid.

paid_to_bank_agent.title: {ticker}: payout sent to the paying agent
paid_to_bank_agent.body: You chose the bank route: the paying agent received your payout and will confirm the bank transfer (SIMULATED).

bank_payout_confirmed.title: {ticker}: bank transfer confirmed
bank_payout_confirmed.body: The paying agent confirmed your bank transfer; its reference is anchored on-chain.
